title: First trip to New York; jamming at Minton's and Sabby Lewis
summary: On a break from the Hines tour he wanted more study, jammed every night at Minton's, where Sabby Lewis offered him a job in Boston.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Now it was with Earl Hines that you first came to New York City, is that right?
That was really part of the same tour was it?

Yeah. And at the time I'd been with the band for a little while and I got the feeling that I wanted to study some more because I was out there for a little while, now I could hear what the guys were doin' and I felt within myself that I really needed some more study. So I was jammin' with...up at the Minton's, you know, we always...if you're off...I think Earl Hines's Band... we were off for about two weeks and so I was around

there and so I'd go up to Minton's, there was nothing else to do, go up to Minton's and jam every night. And that's when Sabby Lewis heard me, you see what I mean. And so he said, "Would you like to go to Boston?" And I'd heard about Boston where there was some good places to study and I said, "Well listen, I got to make a change here." So I went on to Boston with him and it was a beautiful relationship, you know. At first we did the Zanzibar...
